description: Capability for the main window + player-* OS-native windows of DossierFanta M2.2. Allows the frontend to invoke local Rust commands only — no external network access, no shell, no fs directly. M2.1: covers also the player-* OS-native windows via the glob 'player-*' (Window Manager ibrido Cap.17). M2.2 — FIX A2 (F12): explicit core:event:allow-emit + allow-listen so the frontend can subscribe to player-updated events emitted by the Rust backend (save_scouting_note, save_auction_data, set_player_status, assign_player). M2.2 — BUG B2 (Cap.17): core:webview:allow-create-webview-window is mandatory for open_player_window to actually create the OS-native window — without it the command is silently rejected.
